messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Take losartan exactly as prescribed by your doctor.
Follow all directions on your prescription label and read all medication guides or instruction sheets.
Your doctor may occasionally change your dose.
Losartan is usually taken once per day.
You may take losartan with or without food.
Call your doctor if you are sick with vomiting or diarrhea, or if you are sweating more than usual.
You can easily become dehydrated while taking losartan.
Dehydrated can lead to very low blood pressure, a serious electrolyte imbalance, or kidney failure.
Your blood pressure will need to be checked often.
You may need frequent blood tests.
If you have high blood pressure, keep using Losartan even if you feel well.
High blood pressure often has no symptoms.
Store tightly closed at room temperature, away from moisture, heat, and light.
Triplet: ["dehydration", "can lead to", "kidney failure"]

The relation 'can lead to' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject condition or event may result in the serious medical condition or complication specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'has severity': The medical condition or effect specified by the subject has the severity specified by the object entity.
B. 'has serious side effect': The subject drug may cause the serious or potentially dangerous adverse effect specified by the object entity that requires medical attention.
C. 'can occur when': The condition specified by the subject entity may arise under the circumstances described by the object entity.
D. 'occur regardless of': The medical event or condition specified by the subject entity can happen irrespective of the presence or absence of the factor specified by the object entity.
E. 'known as': The subject medical condition is also referred to by the name specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.

Answer:
